columns.name: name
columns.note: Localised item name. Placeholder rows keep Japanese names even in Western slots.

columns.name: sort_key
columns.note: Orders items inside a category (weapons 0..4 = weapon kind; others ascend).

columns.name: variant
columns.note: Meaning unresolved; preserve.

columns.name: category
columns.note: 0 weapons 153, 1 armour 750, 2 tools 175, 3 furniture 399, 4 consumables 623, 5 materials 459, 6 key items 30, 7 bounties 146. Rows are grouped by category; code reads this byte at row+8.

columns.name: item_type
columns.note: Sub-kind (85 sword, 105 helmet, 111 shield, 92 pickaxe, 26 water, 118 generic).

columns.name: required_level
columns.note: 0 = none; 5..100 otherwise (Origin Island clothing uses 30-40).

columns.name: stack_limit
columns.note: 1 for gear/furniture, 99 for consumables/materials.

columns.name: icon_index
columns.note: Row in the icon table (ids 8686-8694, 4995 rows); code reads this halfword at row+12. Placeholder items use 1 ("Dummy").

columns.name: quality_flag
columns.note: 0 or 3.

columns.name: equip_slot
columns.note: Equipment slot / tool kind (16 shield, 17 helmet, 33 talisman, 41 pickaxe); 255 = n/a.

columns.name: u_16
columns.note: 1095/1096 (922 key items, 1145-1151 bounties). Not a DLC flag.

columns.name: related_index
columns.note: 65535 none; furniture object index; mirrors u_16 for tools/key items.

columns.name: tier
columns.note: 0..5, 5 on most placeholder/junk rows.

columns.name: flag_20_4
columns.note: 1 on almost all real items.

columns.name: sell_price
columns.note: Dosh, 27-bit packed. HP Potion 30, Healweed 5.

columns.name: buy_price
columns.note: Dosh, 27-bit packed at byte 24 bit 0. HP Potion 60.

columns.name: flag_24_27
columns.note: Set on key items.

columns.name: flag_24_28
columns.note: 1 on real items; 0 on placeholders and bounties.

columns.name: flag_24_29
columns.note: Observed 0 on part of equipment incl. Origin Island pieces.

columns.name: flag_24_30
columns.note: 1 on real tradable items.

columns.name: flag_24_31
columns.note: 1 on real tradable items.
